D: Deadpool drags a reluctant Wolverine into a mission to save his world.
P: Serve the snacks when Deadpool finds Dogpool in the Void.
S: Dogpool, the scruffy little Deadpool from the Void

Cocktail franks in soft mini buns smothered in beef chilli and melted cheddar, with mustard and crispy onions on top. Brown 250g beef mince with 1 diced onion, add 1 tbsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin and 400g crushed tomatoes and simmer 20 minutes until thick. Heat 16 cocktail frankfurts in simmering water for 5 minutes. Split 16 mini hot dog buns or soft dinner rolls and fill with the franks. Spoon over the chilli, top with 120g grated cheddar and grill for 2 minutes until melted. Finish with mustard and crispy fried onions.
Fried tortilla rolls of beef, refried beans and cheese
Mini fried burritos filled with spiced beef, beans and cheese, with sour cream and salsa.
Paper thin fried potato chips tossed in smoked paprika and garlic powder
Potatoes sliced thin on a mandoline, fried at 170C until crisp, tossed straight away with smoked paprika, garlic powder and salt.
M: Wade's birthday party with his friends

Pork ribs rubbed with paprika and brown sugar, slow cooked until tender, glazed and charred on the grill, with buttered corn and slaw. Rub 2kg pork ribs with 2 tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp garlic powder and 2 tsp salt. Wrap in foil and cook at 150C for 3 hours. Unwrap, brush with 250ml barbecue sauce and grill over high heat for 5 minutes, turning, until sticky and charred. Boil 4 corn cobs for 6 minutes and butter them. Toss half a shredded cabbage and 1 grated carrot with mayo and lemon.
Beef mince chilli with tomatoes and kidney beans
Beef and kidney bean chilli simmered with cumin and tomato, served with cheddar and corn chips.
W: Vanilla ice cream with raspberry sauce and mango puree
Vanilla ice cream in tall glasses, half spooned over with raspberry sauce and half with mango purée, whipped cream piled on top.
K: Whisky, lime and bitters topped with ginger, over big ice

Whisky over a big block of ice, topped with spicy ginger ale, fresh lime and a dash of bitters, rough edges and all. Put one large ice cube or a few big ones into each of 4 tall glasses. Pour in 45ml whisky, the juice of a quarter of a lime and a dash of bitters. Top slowly with about 150ml cold ginger ale and stir once. Garnish with a lime wedge. For non-drinkers, swap the whisky for cold strong tea with a squeeze of lime.

s.note: Fried tortilla rolls of beef, refried beans and cheese
s.how: Brown 400g beef mince with 1 tbsp taco seasoning, add 400g refried beans and cool. Fill 8 small tortillas with the mix and 120g grated cheese, roll tightly and fry seam down at 180C until golden. Halve and serve with 200g sour cream and 300g salsa.

s.note: Paper thin fried potato chips tossed in smoked paprika and garlic powder
s.how: Slice 800g potatoes paper thin on a mandoline and rinse well. Dry thoroughly and fry at 170C in batches until crisp. Toss straight away with smoked paprika, garlic powder and sea salt. Serve in a big bowl, dusty as a wasteland.

m.note: Beef mince chilli with tomatoes and kidney beans
m.how: Brown 800g beef mince with 1 diced onion and 3 crushed garlic cloves. Add 2 tbsp chilli powder, 1 tsp ground cumin, a 400g can crushed tomatoes and a 400g can drained kidney beans. Simmer for 40 minutes, then serve with grated cheddar and corn chips.

w.note: Vanilla ice cream with raspberry sauce and mango puree
w.how: Blend 200g raspberries with a spoon of sugar and strain. Blend a mango until smooth. Scoop vanilla ice cream into tall glasses, spoon raspberry sauce down one side and mango down the other, then pile whipped cream on top.

d.note: Whisky, lime and bitters topped with ginger, over big ice
d.how: Put one large ice cube or a few big ones into each of 4 tall glasses. Pour in 45ml whisky, the juice of a quarter of a lime and a dash of bitters. Top slowly with about 150ml cold ginger ale and stir once. Garnish with a lime wedge. For non-drinkers, swap the whisky for cold strong tea with a squeeze of lime.
